## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A single-*juan* late-Táng auxiliary liturgical apparatus by Zhànrán 湛然 (711–782) supplementing Zhìyǐ's *Fǎhuá sānmèi chànyí* ([KR6d0191](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0191), T1941). The work provides additional practical instruction for the *Fǎhuá sānmèi* practice, including detailed visualisation (*yùnxiǎng* 運想) procedures that Zhìyǐ's foundational text had left implicit.

**Abstract**

Zhànrán's *Bǔzhù yí* belongs together with the brief *Lüè Fǎhuá sānmèi bǔzhù yí* ([KR6d0193](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0193)) and the *Lǐ Fǎhuájīng yíshì* ([KR6d0194](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0194)) as the principal Táng-period supplementary liturgical apparatus for the standard Tiāntái Lotus Sūtra repentance cycle. The composition is bracketed within Zhànrán's mature productive period c. 750–782.
